kevin: Quick follow-up from the postmortem (autoscale surge + quota exhaustion). TL;DR: we have three concrete action items, owners assigned below. Please ack and add any blockers.
sarah: Ack — I'll take scheduler tuning (A1). Plan: adjust bin-packing thresholds, reduce preemption margin, and add a cooldown to reactive scale-ups. Target: PR by Tue EOD (2026-04-07). @kevin can you add me to the perf dashboard? :+1:
anil: Taking quota/backstop (A2). I'll prototype a temporary conservative quota-bump policy and a per-customer throttling shim. Need access to cloud-quota view and the quota-runbook. ETA: prototype by Fri 2026-04-10. Quick note: current quota queries are in infra-stats -> `quota_service` endpoint.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0423-01. Linked postmortem: /pm/2026-04-23-autoscale-surge. Auto-reminder set for owners in 72h.
maria: I'll own headroom planning (A3). Proposal sketch: compute target_headroom = ceil(p95_rps * 1.5) + safety_buffer(100_gpus). Will run backtest over last 90d and share numbers. Plan to land a spreadsheet + runbook section by Mon 2026-04-06. Also propose a small dashboard card for headroom utilization.
tyler: Can we do a 30m async sync Wed 2026-04-08 10:30 PT? Focus: unblock A1/A2 and confirm rollout gating. If no objections I'll create a calendar invite.
jason: I'll add a canary/regression job for autoscale on the test pool (ENG-4412). It will run synthetic 95th workload and validate scale-down doesn't drop below headroom. ETA: Friday.
kevin: Summary and owners:
- A1 scheduler tuning — sarah — PR by 2026-04-07, rollout canary -> full by 2026-04-14
- A2 quota/backstop policy — anil — prototype by 2026-04-10, ops config by 2026-04-15
- A3 headroom calc + dashboard — maria — spreadsheet+runbook by 2026-04-06
- Canary/regression tests — jason — test job by 2026-04-10
- Sync meeting — tyler to schedule Wed 2026-04-08 10:30 PT
Blockers called out so far: sarah needs perf dashboard access, anil needs quota-runbook perms. If infra access is blocking, ping @infra-admins channel or DM me.
kevin: Please react with :white_check_mark: when you accept owner/dates or reply with constraints. I'll post a weekly status update into #headroom-ops every Monday until all items are closed. Thanks everyone.
